small_rewards_added_occurred.meaning: GTELaunchpadV2Pair continuously adds small reward amounts to the distributor as swap fees

pending_rewards.meaning: pending reward token amount held by the distributor before the acc-rewards-per-share update

precision_factor.meaning: PRECISION_FACTOR scaling constant applied to pendingRewards

total_shares.meaning: total shares used as the divisor in the acc-rewards-per-share computation

pending_rewards_after_update.meaning: pending reward token amount remaining after the acc-rewards-per-share update when truncation to zero occurs

cumulative_losses_over_time_occurred.meaning: significant cumulative reward losses accumulate over time as small pending rewards are truncated

assumptions: The acc-rewards-per-share update is the checked transition that consumes pendingRewards.
pendingRewards and totalShares are observable integer quantities at the pre-update checkpoint.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the exact PRECISION_FACTOR value, so the truncation threshold cannot be numerically instantiated; the relation is kept symbolic.
Report does not specify whether truncation loss occurs per-update or cumulatively across updates, so the cumulative-loss checkpoint is only qualitatively grounded.

limitations: Conservation is stated at the amount level: the desired relation is that pending rewards are not reduced to zero by truncation when pendingRewards * PRECISION_FACTOR < totalShares.
The impact is qualitative ('significant cumulative losses over time'); no numeric magnitude is supplied.
Caller/permissionless context is not stated and is not encoded.
